scope: development extension after sparse single-component training; existing observed regression only
profiles: Reuse exact 12 frozen character-crossfit profiles/calibrations from layout_risk training_v1; no rebuilding or target fold inclusion
tasks: Every nonroot leaf component with >=2 strokes, public confidence>=0.8 and compatible train-fold candidates. Each component is proposed independently against A, never combine multiple proposals in a glyph
fixed: Same D/M donor choice, M_D_1.0 proposal, 22 inference-only features, score labels, distance<=2, minimum5 votes, maximum8 votes, scale floor0.1, thresholds and quality gates
grouping: One label per author-character-component after averaging repeat captures; query character excluded across authors; feature IQR from median features per author-character; only nearest component in each author-character group may vote
control: Single-component prior examples replayed through identical grouped learner; retain original A/D/M and the old source candidate. Any new decision is from expanded evidence and grouping, not changed trajectories or donor selection
selection: Choose among all-component development arms only; strictly lower mean geometry vsD, angle<=D+0.5deg, every character<=1.05D, each stroke max-error increment<=0.005, unchanged donors; tie lower geometry, author, higher threshold; otherwise D
regression: Use frozen choice on existing 42 user001 and 144 scx/mjb/wsq cases; single-component control at same frozen scope/threshold; no regression tuning
limits: No fresh test claim, no calibrated naturalness probability, overlapping characters and components not independent samples; crossfit/full-train distribution shift remains
